verses.text: Then Moses and Israel’s people sang this song to Yahweh: ‘I’ll sing to Yahweh—he has won a glorious victory! He threw horse and rider into the sea. 🎶
‘Yahweh is my strength and my song. He rescued me. He is my God, and I’ll praise him; my father’s God, and I’ll honor him. 🙌
‘Yahweh is a warrior. Yahweh is his name. ⚔️
‘He threw Pharaoh’s chariots and army into the sea. His best officers sank in the Red Sea. 🌊
‘Deep water covered them. They sank to the depths like a stone. 🪨
‘Yahweh, your right hand is powerful and glorious! Your right hand smashes the enemy. 💪
‘With your great majesty, you knock down those who rise against you. You send out your anger, and it burns them up like dry straw. 🔥
‘One breath from you piled the waters up. The waves stood like a wall; the depths froze in the middle of the sea. 🌊
‘The enemy bragged, “I’ll chase them down, catch them, and divide the loot. I’ll get everything I want. I’ll draw my sword and wipe them out!” 😠
‘But you blew your wind, and the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters. 🌬️
‘Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you—glorious in holiness, awesome in praise, doing wonders? ✨
‘You stretched out your right hand, and the earth swallowed them. 🌍
‘In your loyal love, you led the people you redeemed. In your strength, you guided them to your holy home. 🛡️
‘The nations heard and shook. The people of Philistia were seized with terror. 😨
‘Edom’s chiefs panicked; Moab’s mighty men trembled; everyone living in Canaan lost heart. 🌍
‘Terror and dread fell over them. Your mighty arm made them still as stone until your people crossed over—the people you bought for yourself. 🪨
‘You’ll bring them in and plant them on your mountain, the land you chose as your home—the sanctuary, Lord, that your hands established. 🏔️
‘Yahweh will reign forever and ever!’ 👑
That’s what they sang because Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and horsemen went into the sea, and Yahweh brought the waters back over them—while Israel walked on dry land through the sea. 🌊
Miriam the prophet, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine. All the women followed her with tambourines and dancing. 🥁
Miriam sang back to them: ‘Sing to Yahweh—he has won a glorious victory! He threw horse and rider into the sea!’ 🎶
Moses led Israel away from the Red Sea and into the wilderness of Shur. They traveled for three days but couldn’t find water. 🏜️
When they reached Marah, they couldn’t drink its water because it was bitter. That’s why the place was named Marah, meaning ‘Bitter.’ 💧
The people complained to Moses, ‘What are we supposed to drink?’ 😟
Moses cried out to Yahweh. Yahweh showed him a piece of wood. Moses threw it into the water, and the water turned sweet. There Yahweh gave the people a rule and instruction, and tested them. 🌿

Yahweh said, ‘If you carefully listen to the voice of Yahweh your God, do what is right in his eyes, pay attention to his commands, and keep all his rules, I won’t put on you the diseases I brought on Egypt. I am Yahweh, your healer.’ 🕊️
Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees. They camped beside the water. 🌴
